description: On a phone, the header's New button is a plain plus immediately left of the Call button. "The plus" is the button inside ".header" whose accessible name is exactly "New Conversation"; "the call button" is data-testid "live-call-header". Do the steps in order, and repeat steps 1-3 for each width W of 320, 390 and 1280 in turn: 1. Set the viewport to W x 800 (a set_viewport giving only width and height, so the phone keeps its touch screen and scale) and navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The plus and the call button should both be visible. 3. Compare their bounding boxes. If W < 768: the plus's right edge (x + width) must be <= the call button's x; the gap (call x minus plus right edge) must be < 8; the plus's computed background-color must be exactly "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"; and the computed width of the svg inside the plus must be exactly "22px". Otherwise (W = 1280): the call button's right edge must be <= the plus's x. After the three widths: 4. Set the viewport to 390x800 (width and height only; no navigation) and click the plus. 5. The URL should become exactly /new: that path, with no query or hash.

steps.expression: (() => { const plus = document.querySelector('.header [aria-label="New Conversation"]'); const call = document.querySelector('[data-testid="live-call-header"]'); const pr = plus.getBoundingClientRect(); const cr = call.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!(pr.right <= cr.left)) throw new Error('plus right ' + pr.right + ' not <= call x ' + cr.left); if (!(cr.left - pr.right < 8)) throw new Error('gap ' + (cr.left - pr.right) + ' not < 8'); const bg = getComputedStyle(plus).backgroundColor; if (bg !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') throw new Error('bg-color: ' + bg); const svg = plus.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg) throw new Error('no svg'); const svgW = getComputedStyle(svg).width; if (svgW !== '22px') throw new Error('svg width: ' + svgW); return 'ok'; })()
